results.fact: which approach this route describes — Esmeralda Basin/Fortune Creek Pass vs. De Roux Creek Trail
results.correct_value: Every source found describes the standard scramble from the Boulder-De Roux Trail #1392 (TH ~3,800 ft), leaving the trail at the house-sized boulder at the last switchback (~5,500-5,600 ft) for ~1,100 ft of Class 2 scree; ~7 mi round trip, ~3,100 ft gain.
results.evidence: The peak's route page calls De Roux Creek the primary route (3 mi west up the valley between Esmeralda and Koppen, then 1,100 ft of Class 2 scree). The hiking-association page gives the same departure (house-sized boulder at the last switchback, 5,600 ft). A detailed trip report gives Boulder-De Roux TH 3,800 ft, leave the trail ~5,500 ft at the final switchback, 7 mi and 3,100 ft. No source describes leaving the Esmeralda Basin trail at Fortune Creek Pass and scrambling to the summit, so the Fortune Creek Pass content (overview sentence, approach, descent, descent_text, climbing_route, bail, pro_tips, itinerary, timing note) is unsupported. Not patched: the fix is a whole-route rewrite of about ten fields, and the route's name '(Esmeralda Basin)' ties the record to the basin, which needs an owner decision rather than minimal patches.

results.fact: trailhead elevation for the same named trailhead
results.evidence: The waypoint's coordinates (47.4366,-120.9370) are the road-end Esmeralda Basin trailhead. The club route description puts the road-end parking at 4,243 ft; the hiking-association page gives a 5,960 ft high point with 1,750 ft gain (TH ~4,210 ft). The row's road, itinerary and the sibling route's identical trailhead waypoint use 4,269 ft, within rounding of both; 3,800 ft is the De Roux trailhead's figure. The waypoint note, which conflates the two trailheads, belongs to the unresolved approach question and is left alone.

results.fact: East Peak summit elevation vs sibling route's description
results.evidence: Esmeralda Peaks East is a separate summit about 1.5 mi east of the main peak, at 6,480 ft with 320 ft prominence; an ice/mixed first-ascent report gives it ca 6,500 ft, and an East Gully trip report calls it the +6480 point at the east end. The '~10 ft apart' east/west pair in the sibling route are the twin summits of the main 6,765 ft peak, a different pair.

results.fact: Total route distance shown as header Dist
results.evidence: dist_km renders as the one-way approach; 14.5 km (~9 mi) is the one-way Buck Creek Trail approach to the Pass No Pass camp, matching the approach and itinerary, while the summit waypoint's 11 mi is the one-way distance to the summit beyond camp. Different quantities, both consistent.

results.fact: Gain vs loss for an out-and-back route
results.evidence: 7,900 ft matches one published route description's gain for Fortress WITH Chiwawa Mountain included (~20 mi RT, overnight), so loss_ft appears to carry the combined-trip total, while gain_ft 5,884 is simply summit minus trailhead (8,679 - 2,800) and understates any real car-to-car gain. No source gives a Fortress-only car-to-car gain, so the single correct figure for both columns is not settled.
